We’re sorry money is tight right now—let’s focus on keeping costs down.

You can:

If one HSA/FSA card doesn’t have enough funds, pay with a credit card and submit the Flex receipt to your provider instead of trying to split across multiple HSA/FSA cards.

Based on this, the most budget-friendly setup is usually Free Shipping + Afterpay (if you’re eligible), and using Flex/HSA/FSA reimbursement when applicable to reduce your out‑of‑pocket cost.
